release_notes: New: the landing create/edit form now matches Keitaro. The landing type is chosen from four tabs (Local / Redirect / Preload / Action) instead of a dropdown. A local landing gets a named folder (/lander/<slug>) so its files unpack into a readable directory rather than landings/<id>/ — existing landings are backfilled a slug from their name, and renaming the slug moves the folder. A redirect landing can pick its redirect method (HTTP 302 / JavaScript / Meta refresh) like an offer. The offer-link hint shows a copy button on every snippet and, for redirect landings, the three integration shapes an external page needs (plain HTML, document.write JS, server-side PHP with _token). Localised across all seven UI languages.
